artefact: a record variable in which a cyclone centre is an extractable feature
declared_by: Edward Jonathan Bentley, maintainer (scientific choice); drafted by Claude Opus 5 at the maintainer's direction and NOT VALID until the maintainer has reviewed and adopted it
why_this_exists: T4E.17 signed an external catalogue and then measured that it cannot be joined to the acquired record: features extracted from 850 hPa temperature sit a median 153.9 km from IBTrACS cyclone centres, against a catalogue radius whose median is 15.2 km, and no storm of 18 has three features within 50 km. The blocker is the record's variable, not the catalogue and not the signature. This acquisition is the only thing that makes kind_recurrence evaluable, and the maintainer authorised it on 2026-09-10.

the_variable.name: vorticity
the_variable.meaning: relative vorticity, ERA5 pressure-level variable, distinct from potential_vorticity
the_variable.level: 850 hPa, the same level as the existing record
the_variable.why_relative_vorticity: It is the standard field for tropical-cyclone tracking, and a cyclone is a compact, near-isotropic extremum in it. Background values are of order 1e-5 s^-1 and a tropical cyclone at 850 hPa reaches 1e-4 to 5e-4, so the signal is an order of magnitude above the field it sits in -- which is the shape the registered extractor declares it assumes.
the_variable.why_NOT_mean_sea_level_pressure_even_tho: IBTrACS records minimum central pressure directly (WMO_PRES, USA_PRES), so MSLP would be the variable most commensurate with the catalogue's own definition of a centre. It is NOT chosen, and the reason is a constraint rather than a scientific preference, which is disclosed rather than dressed up: `cds_source.py` refuses any dataset except `reanalysis-era5-pressure-levels` by design, and MSLP is a single-level variable. Acquiring it would mean extending the acquisition layer to a second dataset, which is a larger change than this task needs and would be its own decision.
the_variable.what_this_costs_in_honesty: The chosen variable is the best available within the machinery as it stands, not the best available in principle. If vorticity fails the acceptance below, MSLP remains the stronger candidate and the acquisition layer would have to be extended to reach it.

the_sign_convention_is_declared_before_t.the_problem: `local_maximum_extractor` finds local MAXIMA. In the SOUTHERN HEMISPHERE cyclonic rotation is NEGATIVE relative vorticity. A maximum-finder run on raw vorticity in this crop would therefore locate ANTICYCLONES and miss every tropical cyclone in the catalogue.
the_sign_convention_is_declared_before_t.the_convention: The field is negated before extraction, so that cyclonic rotation is a positive peak. Every feature extracted under this convention is a cyclonic centre by construction.
the_sign_convention_is_declared_before_t.why_this_is_declared_and_not_slipped_in: Negation is a transformation this programme chose, not a property of the data. Declaring it before the record exists is what stops it becoming a knob turned after a disappointing result, and it is recorded here for the same reason the radius and the kind label were.
the_sign_convention_is_declared_before_t.it_applies_to_this_crop_because_of_where: The crop is entirely south of the equator, latitude -58 to -18 after the crop amendment, and -60 to -20 before it, so a single sign applies throughout and no hemisphere test is needed. A crop spanning the equator would need one, and this design does not cover that case.

the_request.expected_shape: 161 x 161, identical to the existing record
the_request.expected_size: of order 230 MB, scaled from the existing record's 338.905 MB over six years for one pressure-level variable of the same shape  [SUPERSEDED: the actual transfer was 336.9 MB over 48 shards. The estimate scaled the temperature record by four sixths of its span and assumed comparable compression; vorticity is a noisier field and compresses less well. The preflight's 2x safety factor absorbed it, but the figure was wrong and is corrected rather than left standing.]

why_the_window_stops_at_2021.the_reason: 2022-2023 is the forecast-test period. It is closed by standing constraint, and NOT ACQUIRING IT makes the reservation physical rather than a matter of policy: a frame that does not exist on this machine cannot be opened by accident, by a future refactor, or by someone who has not read the constraint.
why_the_window_stops_at_2021.what_that_costs: A confirmatory evaluation would later need those two years, and acquiring them then would be a second request with its own queue time. That cost is accepted deliberately: the programme has spent this session learning that reservations enforced in code outlast reservations recorded in prose, and one enforced in physics outlasts both.
why_the_window_stops_at_2021.the_catalogue_side_is_already_counted: IBTrACS lists 393 in-box observations from 13 storms in 2022-2023. That was counted from the catalogue and remains unmatched against any frame.

acceptance_for_the_acquired_record.why_acceptance_is_declared_before_the_da: T4E.17's catalogue was checked for independence, for the source of its radius and for the adequacy of its population, and was never checked for whether the record's variable could SEE what the catalogue labels. That question was answerable before any code ran and was not asked. This section is that question, asked in advance.
acceptance_for_the_acquired_record.condition_1_the_join_must_close: Re-running the T4E.17 join probe on the new record, the median distance from an IBTrACS position to the nearest extracted feature must fall INSIDE the catalogue's own per-observation radius for at least half of the 18 storms. On temperature the median was 153.9 km against a radius of 15.2; anything that does not close that gap by an order of magnitude has not repaired the blocker.
acceptance_for_the_acquired_record.condition_2_a_configuration_must_exist: At least half the storms must have three or more features within their own catalogue radius, because a configuration has cardinality 3 and an identity criterion has nothing to work on otherwise.
acceptance_for_the_acquired_record.condition_3_the_extractor_must_not_be_sw: Features per frame must remain in a range a constellation enumeration can use. The existing temperature record yields 42 to 86 across ten planes; vorticity at 0.25 degrees is a noisier field and may yield far more. A frame yielding thousands is as unusable as one yielding none, and the budget refusals in `extract_constellations` are the check.
acceptance_for_the_acquired_record.condition_4_refusals_by_name: Frames that cannot be extracted, features refused as unmeasurable, and observations without a catalogue radius are all counted and surfaced, never defaulted.
acceptance_for_the_acquired_record.what_failure_would_mean: That relative vorticity at 850 hPa, under the declared sign convention, does not put an extractable feature at a catalogue cyclone centre. It would NOT mean the catalogue is wrong or the signature fails, and it would leave MSLP as the next candidate, reachable only by extending the acquisition layer to single-level data.

what_this_acquisition_does_NOT_authorise: It evaluates no criterion. A rule for this evidence needs its own declaration, written before any of these numbers shape it.
It does not open the 2022-2023 forecast-test period, and the frames are deliberately not acquired.

It does not replace the existing temperature record, which stays as it is at content_hash e488f5c3d480f072c834dceae1eeea2a; this is a second record and comparisons between them are cross-variable, not cross-time.
It approves no mining radius, discharges no part of T4E.8's acquired-record acceptance, and closes none of D96 to D100.
It says nothing about recurrence across genuinely separated epochs.

operational_prerequisites_the_maintainer.credentials: The acquisition layer builds a standard `cdsapi.Client()`, which reads `~/.cdsapirc` or the CDSAPI_URL and CDSAPI_KEY environment variables. Neither is present on this machine. The maintainer must create that configuration; the credential is never to be pasted into this conversation, never recorded in this repository, and `cds_source.py` already states that credentials are never recorded in its receipts.
operational_prerequisites_the_maintainer.licence: The ERA5 licence must be accepted once on the CDS website for the account in question, or every request is refused at submission.
operational_prerequisites_the_maintainer.network_consent: The layer refuses to submit unless `allow_network=True` or SPECTRALEARTH_ALLOW_NETWORK=1 is set explicitly, which is a second deliberate act and not a side effect of running anything.
operational_prerequisites_the_maintainer.the_code_change_this_needs: `CDS_VARIABLES` maps five variables and does not include vorticity. One entry is added; the dataset, schema and request shape are unchanged.

governing_rules: Nothing reaches the network without the maintainer's explicit say-so. It was given on 2026-09-10 for this acquisition.
Bind the record by its content identity; the acquired store is verified by content hash and the frame count is checked exactly against the expected calendar.
A named refusal is preferable to an unsupported number.
Code does not sign catalogues, events or scientific preregistrations for a person; this design is not adopted until the maintainer says so.
Already inspected data do not become untouched by renaming them.
claim_boundary: An acquired record is evidence, not a result. Nothing here settles anything about the atmosphere, and no frame of the 2022-2023 forecast-test period is acquired or opened by any part of this.

amendment_2026_09_10_the_crop_was_wrong_.why: The design copied the existing record's crop, latitude -60 to -20. A two-month probe showed that crop cannot support the evaluation whatever the variable: 707 of 917 South Pacific cyclone observations in this longitude band lie NORTH of -20 and are excluded, and the 210 that remain have median latitude -23.3 with 74 within two degrees of the northern edge, where the extractor refuses features by design. The variable was confirmed in the same probe -- a cyclone sits at the 0.02nd percentile of its frame, one grid cell from the catalogue position -- so the crop was the only thing left to change.
amendment_2026_09_10_the_crop_was_wrong_.the_rule_that_chose_the_new_crop: Extend north only while the INFORMATIVE MINORITY of the kind label keeps growing, and stop where it saturates. This is stated from the label distribution alone, before any criterion runs, so it cannot be a choice of whichever box flatters a result.
amendment_2026_09_10_the_crop_was_wrong_.why_that_rule_lands_on_minus_18: The non-TS population saturates exactly there. Interior SS counts run 37, 38, 39 as the northern edge moves -20, -19, -18, and then stay at 39 for every edge from -18 to -10. ET stays at 5 and the non-TS storm count at 9 throughout. Every observation gained north of -18 is TS, which dilutes the label and adds nothing informative.
amendment_2026_09_10_the_crop_was_wrong_.what_was_rejected_and_why: The -45..-5 box gives 30 storms and 683 interior observations, but its NATURE base rate is 0.872: a rule answering 'same kind' to everything would be right 87 per cent of the time. It buys TS-only data at the cost of the label. There is no sweet spot on this curve -- the trade-off is smooth and monotone from 0.464 to 0.872 -- so the choice had to come from a rule rather than from an inflection.

the_new_crop.shape: 161 x 161 at 0.25 degrees, the shape the crop planner assessed, shifted 2 degrees north

amendment_2026_09_10_the_crop_was_wrong_.against_the_old_crop: Interior observations rise from 113 to 176 and interior storms from 13 to 18, the whole non-TS population is captured rather than 42 of 44, and the interior base rate moves from 0.464 to 0.571 -- a real cost, disclosed, and far short of the 0.872 the tropical box would have imposed.
amendment_2026_09_10_the_crop_was_wrong_.what_this_does_to_the_signed_catalogue: T4E.17 was signed on terms naming the OLD crop and its population. This is a different evidence base, so the signature is re-given on the new terms rather than carried over, and the old figures are superseded in place rather than edited out.

acquisition_outcome.status: ACQUIRED, and the acceptance FAILED on conditions 1 and 2.
acquisition_outcome.verdict: The variable carries the signal and the extractor does not find it. Conditions 1 and 2 were met by 2 of 18 and 1 of 18 storms against a declared bar of 9. The crop and the representation were both cleared by further measurement; the diagnosis is the extractor's phase-randomised frame-maximum calibration.
acquisition_outcome.what_the_acquisition_bought: The diagnosis. Without the record the failure would still have been attributed to the variable, which the measurement shows to be wrong.
